ValidationRule.description: Date to be Moved on Call must be current or future date. It cannot be in the Past.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType_Name__c = "CAC - DP Closure" && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_to_be_Moved_on_Call__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_to_be_Moved_on_Call__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_to_be_Moved_on_Call__c) < TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_to_be_Moved_on_Call__c)) || DATEVALUE(Date_to_be_Moved_on_Call__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Date_to_be_Moved_on_Call__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_to_be_Moved_on_Call__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_to_be_Moved_on_Call__c) < TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date to be Moved on Call must be current or future date. It cannot be in the Past.
